plan.bitcode_input_constraint: Inspection before any holdout build/timing found that these release rlibs contain LLVM bitcode only. Use opt-level=3, fat LTO, codegen-units=1 and panic=abort for the new probe, and verify actual entry/scanner instructions in both labels before timing. This re-links/re-optimizes the existing exact rlib inputs; it does not reuse linked machine-code addresses.
plan.instrumentation_control: In matched placements, put the shared diagnostic-counter storage at the same fixed address in both labels, avoiding a separate cache-line offset confound from instrumentation. The default-linked control retains default storage placement.
plan.limits: This is a separate batched workload, not a replacement or rerun of the original single-fixture Criterion measurements. It changes timer amortization and live fixture count equally for both labels; all original adverse results remain visible.
plan.method: Use the exact existing secure page-benchmark rlibs (including the documented baseline flag-store patch), with the same fat-LTO release pipeline as the original benchmark. Prepare 32 independent fixtures outside each timed interval, time a batch of 32 transitions, and accumulate 8192 intervals after 128 warmup batches. Preserve the default-linked batched control, then test every 16-byte placement in a cache line with both fixture entry and scanner placed equally for baseline and candidate; caller placement is fixed equally.
